evidence_required: five meanings and an ordering with one-line justification.

marking.criterion: PIX (at most one PCIe bridge) and PXB (multiple bridges, no host bridge) defined
PHB (through a PCIe host bridge, typically the CPU) defined
NODE (between host bridges within a NUMA node) and SYS (across the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes) defined
Ordering best to worst: PIX, PXB, PHB, NODE, SYS
Justification: each step adds bridges, root-complex or inter-socket traversal, lowering P2P bandwidth and raising variance; GDR may be refused beyond the NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL gate
